source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-color landscape with sparse misty washes, distant rocky ridge, pine and bamboo vegetation, a small shelter containing a reclining figure, foreground rocks, and quiet shoreline/water lines. Calligraphy and seals at the upper right are excluded from all motifs.

motifs.name: central_twisting_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central pine: curved trunk rising from the lower middle to the upper middle, angular branches extending left and right, and clustered pine-needle tufts. Extract only the tree forms, not the calligraphy, hut, rocks, or distant ridge behind it.
must_preserve: dry dark trunk strokes with broken ink edges
angular branch linework crossing the center
short radiating pine-needle clusters
ink-density variations along the trunk and branch joints
small pale gaps between needles and branches

motifs.name: left_tree_bamboo_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the left-side vegetation group with the leaning dark trunk, sparse brushy foliage, and bamboo leaves around the lower-left slope. Include the visible stems and leaves belonging to this cluster only.
must_preserve: leaning dark trunk with rough dry-brush texture
thin vertical and diagonal bamboo stems
pointed bamboo leaf clusters
loose ink washes around the root area
contrasting heavy black accents and pale gray strokes

motifs.name: mid_slope_pine_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal band of low pine boughs and brushy shrubs crossing the middle hillside, including the small needle tufts and sweeping branch strokes just above the hut area. Do not include the main central pine trunk or the hut.
must_preserve: long sweeping branch contours
small repeated pine-needle sprays
dry-brush shrub marks
gray hillside wash beneath the foliage
broken, calligraphic ink line quality

motifs.name: small_shelter_with_reclining_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the small rustic shelter beneath the trees with its slanted roof, simple wall lines, platform, and the reclining human figure inside with reddish-orange clothing accents.
must_preserve: sloping roof geometry outlined in dark ink
soft gray roof wash and dry eave strokes
rectangular platform and wall linework
small reclining figure with black hair and pale face
reddish-orange robe or sleeve accents

motifs.name: foreground_rock_terrace
motifs.description: Isolate the clustered foreground rock terrace below and left of the shelter, including layered boulders, dark ink accents, root-like lines, and scrubby texture marks. Exclude the hut and tall pine trunk where possible.
must_preserve: irregular rock outlines in dry ink
dark black accent patches
gray wash modeling on rock faces
short vertical texture strokes
root-like curving lines around the stones

motifs.name: right_lakeside_standing_rock
motifs.description: Isolate the pale upright rock mass on the lower right with its thin contour lines, light gray wash, and small dark marks near the base. Include only the rock and its immediate base, not the broader water lines.
must_preserve: delicate angular rock outline
pale interior wash
subtle dry-brush cracks and texture marks
small dark ink accents near the lower edge
open unpainted interior space of the rock

motifs.name: distant_right_mountain_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the distant mountain ridge behind the central tree on the right, with soft gray wash slopes, darker ridge contours, and dry vertical texture marks. Exclude pine branches passing over it and exclude all calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: soft layered gray mountain wash
dark broken contour along the ridge crest
pale misty edges fading into the background
vertical dry-brush texture strokes on the slope
subtle tonal separation between near and far peaks

motifs.name: bottom_shore_water_lines
motifs.description: Isolate the quiet shoreline and water indication at the bottom: long horizontal ink lines and faint washes beneath the rocks. Do not include the large foreground rocks except for the minimal contact shadows needed to anchor the water.
must_preserve: thin horizontal waterline strokes
slightly uneven dry-brush edges
faint gray wash beneath the shore
minimal dark contact marks at rock bases
wide empty spacing that suggests calm water

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
